title: Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Proposal for Designation of a Waterfront Area)
(1) A proposal for designation of a waterfront area under Article 4 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall use Attached Form 1.
(2) A proposal for modification of a waterfront area and a proposal for cancellation of designation of a waterfront area under Article 4 (4) of the Decree shall use Attached Form 1.

Article 3 (Applications for Permission for Activities)
(1) A person applying under Article 9 (1) of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") for permission or amended permission for an activity listed in a subparagraph of Article 9 (1) of the Decree shall submit the application for permission (amended permission) for activities in Attached Form 2.
(2) A report under Article 9 (4) of the Decree shall use the report on the progress of construction (project) in Attached Form 3.

Article 4 (Application to Undertake a Waterfront Area Development Project on Behalf of the Project Implementer)
An application to undertake a waterfront area development project on behalf of the project implementer under Article 12 (1) of the Decree shall use Attached Form 4.

Article 5 (Application for Approval of an Implementation Plan)
An application for approval of an implementation plan under Article 13 (1) of the Decree shall use Attached Form 5.

Article 6 (Construction Completion Reports)
(1) A construction completion report under Article 16 (1) of the Decree shall use Attached Form 6.
(2) A completion inspection certificate under Article 20 (2) of the Act shall use Attached Form 7.

Article 7 (Application for Use before Completion)
An application under Article 17 (1) of the Decree shall use the application for use before completion in Attached Form 8.

Article 8 (Application for Approval to Supply Developed Land, etc.)
An application for approval to supply developed land, etc. under Article 19 (1) of the Decree shall use Attached Form 9.

Article 9 (Identification of Inspecting Public Officials)
Identification of inspecting public officials under Article 29 (2) of the Act shall use Attached Form 10.

Addenda <Ministerial Ordinance No. 354, April 29, 2011>
These Rules shall enter into force on April 30, 2011.

Addenda (Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Institutions) <Ministerial Ordinance No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 5 omitted.
Article 6 (Amendments to Other Legislation) (1) through (109) omitted.
(110) The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas are partially amended as follows:
In Attached Form 1, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 4, the front of Attached Form 5, Attached Forms 6 through 8, the front of Attached Form 9 and the reverse of Attached Form 10, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" is respectively replaced by "Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport".
In the processing procedure section of Attached Form 1, the processing agency (department in charge) section on the reverse of Attached Form 5, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 6, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 8, the processing agency (department in charge) section on the reverse of Attached Form 9 and the front of Attached Form 10, "Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" is respectively replaced by "Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport".
(111) through (126) omitted.

Addenda (Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Ministry of Environment and Its Affiliated Institutions) <Ministerial Ordinance No. 764, June 8, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendments to Other Legislation) (1) through (6) omitted.
(7) The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas are partially amended as follows:
In the addressee section of Attached Form 1, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 4, the addressee section on the front of Attached Form 5, the addressee section of Attached Form 6, the attachments section of that Form, the official seal section of Attached Form 7, the addressee section of Attached Form 8, the addressee section on the front of Attached Form 9 and the official seal section on the reverse of Attached Form 10, "Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport" is respectively replaced by "Minister of Environment".

Addenda (Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Ministry of Environment and Its Affiliated Institutions) <Ministerial Ordinance No. 958, December 28, 2021>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2022.
Article 2 omitted.
Article 3 (Amendments to Other Legislation) (1) The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas are partially amended as follows:
In Attached Form 1, the reverse of Attached Form 5, Attached Form 6, Attached Form 8, the reverse of Attached Form 9 and Attached Form 10, "Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport" is respectively replaced by "Ministry of Environment".
(2) through (4) omitted.

Addenda (Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Institutions) <Ministerial Ordinance No. 1, October 1, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of promulgation. However, where a ministerial ordinance amended under Article 6 of these Addenda was promulgated before the enforcement of these Rules but has not yet entered into force, the amendment to that ordinance shall enter into force on the enforcement date of the respective ordinance.
Articles 2 through 5 omitted.
Article 6 (Amendments to Other Legislation) (1) through (72) omitted.
(73) The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Utilization of Waterfront Areas are partially amended as follows:
In Attached Form 1, the front of Attached Form 5, Attached Form 6, Attached Form 7, Attached Form 8, the front of Attached Form 9 and the reverse of Attached Form 10, "Minister of Environment" is respectively replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".
In the processing procedure section of Attached Form 1, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 4, the processing procedure section on the reverse of Attached Form 5, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 6, the processing procedure section of Attached Form 8, the processing procedure section on the reverse of Attached Form 9 and the front of Attached Form 10, "Ministry of Environment" is respectively replaced by "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".
(74) through (98) omitted.
